sentences.en: Pesticides are agricultural chemicals that exterminate insects that harm plants.
sentences.zh: 农药是农业化学制品，可以消灭危害植物的昆虫。

sentences.en: Through genetic engineering, corn can produce its own pesticides.
sentences.zh: 通过基因工程，玉米可以自己产生杀虫剂。

sentences.en: We don't use pesticides like those on our farm.
sentences.zh: 我们不使用像农场里的那些农药。

senses.zh: 杀虫剂 形容词: pesticidal

mnemonic: 词根记忆：pesti（=pest害虫）+cid（杀） +e→杀虫剂
